name: Org-mode Latin transcription study minor mode

mentions.name: Org-mode Latin transcription study minor mode
mentions.description: This Emacs Lisp minor mode loads transcribed and analyzed Latin data from a BaseX XML database into an Org-mode transcription buffer for reading and study, storing forced-alignment and linguistic analysis data in hidden text properties so audio of any given Latin word, sentence, or paragraph can be played back.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'll then demonstrate some Emacs Lisp code which pulls it into an Org-mode based transcription buffer and minor-mode for reading and study, where I can play audio of any given Latin word, sentence, or paragraph, thanks to the forced-alignment and linguistic analysis data being stored in hidden text properties when the data was fetched from the database.
